source_quote: The city spirals precisely as we planned, preparing for the true glory that awaits it.

source_quote: Pliinki's Journal: "The egg pulses with new life... My goal is clear, a two-headed wyrmling, a perfect 'Prince's gift' for Demogorgon, to serve as his mount."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembers a text from the temple about the power of Bahamut: "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? The true wyrm's form is not etched by fate's first breath, nor by sorcerous hand. It is the choices that twist the spirit, or set it soaring. To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes.”
source_quote: "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes."

source_quote: Pliinki's Journal: "It didn't just flash this time; the very air around it flared! It hungers for more power, more chaos!"

subject: Cult of Narrak
fact: The Cult of Narrak, operating through covert placements of 'Y' carvings and ideological indoctrination, has convinced nearly all Council members of the Savants to embrace the true path. They seek to deliver Gracklstugh as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon, using the Obelisk and the egg as instruments of ascension.
source_quote: Almost all members have now embraced the true path, thanks to our careful placements of the 'Y' carvings.

subject: Deep King
fact: The Deep King is a ruler of Gracklstugh who is being manipulated by Pliinki through escalating paranoia and erratic edicts, kept in ignorance of the true purpose of the Obelisk and the Red Dragon Egg.
source_quote: Letter 1: "Keep the Deep King 'delighted' in his ignorance."

subject: Empty Scabbard Killers
fact: The Empty Scabbard Killers live to the south.
source_quote: Thorin leads them west, instead of south, where the Empty Scabbard Killers live.

subject: Gray Ghosts
fact: The Gray Ghosts are a thieves' guild who delivered the Red Dragon Egg to Pliinki as part of a covert operation, unaware of its true purpose, and are being used to destabilize Gracklstugh through diversions and misinformation.
source_quote: Letter 1: "Your operatives, those foolish Gray Ghosts, delivered it precisely as planned, though they do not comprehend the true glory of their retrieval."

subject: Gray Ghosts operatives
fact: The Gray Ghosts delivered the Red Dragon Egg as part of Pliinki's plan.
source_quote: The Gray Ghosts delivered it!

subject: Keepers of the Flame
fact: The Keepers of the Flame are a faction in Gracklstugh who believe the Red Dragon Egg is merely a replacement for their wyrm and are in panic over its loss, unaware of its transformation into a demonic vessel.
source_quote: Pliinki's Journal: "The Keepers are in a panic over its loss, believing it merely a 'replacement' for their bloated wyrm."

subject: The Derro
fact: The Derro are a subterranean race under Duergar oppression, with some members like Diirdeklin and Diinarnnmyr hoping for liberation, but now fearing Drow incursions may be part of a larger scheme against them.
source_quote: Pliinki has promised him that this is part of some plan that will free the Derro from the bondage of Duergar.

subject: The Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard is a newly named group of mercenaries led by Thorin, composed of Daz, Grygum, Zalthir, and Thorin, who have adopted a fearsome identity to replace their previous image as desperate survivors.
source_quote: We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!

subject: The Ember Vanguard
fact: The Ember Vanguard is the name chosen by Daz for the group, adopted by all members, and later claimed by a Drow Archmage who summons a meteor swarm to intimidate Derro guards, marking their passage out of the cave.
source_quote: And then he smiles, “I have it - The Ember Vanguard.” ... The Drow shouts, “We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!” ... Diinarnnmyr mutters, “The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes the egg is no longer a dragon but a demonic abomination, and that it must be destroyed to prevent its use in dark designs. He recalls Bahamut's teaching that true freedom lies in breaking chains of corruption, even when madness fuels creation.
source_quote: "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? The true wyrm's form is not etched by fate's first breath, nor by sorcerous hand. It is the choices that twist the spirit, or set it soaring. To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes."

subject: Pliinki's Journal
fact: Pliinki's Journal details her experiments with the Obelisk of Diirinka and the Red Dragon Egg, intending to create a two-headed wyrmling as a mount for Demogorgon and use the Obelisk to conquer Gracklstugh.
source_quote:
Pliinki's Journal
**Day 17 – The Stone of Diirinka**
The Obelisk. Such a magnificent, fractured thing! Hidden here by Diirinka himself, I am certain. Its black metal hums with quasi-magical energy, a power just waiting to be unleashed. I have tried the Thrazgad ore, as Narrak suggested, to mend its cracks, but it merely sits "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches. ... It will conquer Gracklstugh, just as I plan. ... Today, I touched it with a spark of my own will, and it flashed! A mere flicker, but a sign! A squeal of glee escaped me. ... 
**Day 25 – The Prince's Gift Arrives**
The Gray Ghosts delivered it! The Red Dragon Egg! ... This is no mere insurance policy; it is the vessel for my greatest creation, a gift worthy of Demogorgon himself. ... My goal is clear, a two-headed wyrmling, a perfect "Prince's gift" for Demogorgon, to serve as his mount. ... The transformation will make it *perfect*.
**Day 47 – The Obelisk Responds**
I pressed my hand to the Obelisk again, channeling the energy of the Whorlstone Tunnels into its fractures. It didn't just flash this time; the very air around it flared! It hungers for more power, more chaos! This monolith will be the instrument of our ascension, allowing us to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.
**Day 54 – Anticipation and Destiny**
The egg is nearing its time! ... My "creation" for Demogorgon will soon be revealed. The Obelisk, too, senses the coming shift. Its purpose, alongside the egg, is to herald the Prince's arrival and the "genocidal war" that will cleanse this city.

source_quote: The Gray Ghosts delivered it! The Red Dragon Egg!

subject: Red Dragon Egg
fact: The Red Dragon Egg is a magical artifact delivered by the Gray Ghosts, now undergoing mutation to become a two-headed wyrmling destined to serve Demogorgon, and is no longer present in its original form.
source_quote: Pliinki's Journal: "The Red Dragon Egg! What a marvel!... The mutations are taking hold..." ... "There is no egg."

subject: statue of Demogorgon
fact: The statue of Demogorgon is a physical representation of the Prince of Demons, found in the alcove of the mesa, likely used as a focus for ritual or worship by Zalthir and Pliinki’s cult.
source_quote: Zalthir picks up the statue of Demogorgon. "Leemooggoogoon, Demogorgon, two-headed baby dragons - …" he thinks to himself.

subject: statue of Demogorgon
fact: Zalthir picks up the statue of Demogorgon from the alcove in the northeast corner and thinks of it as 'Leemooggoogoon, Demogorgon, two-headed baby dragons - ...'
source_quote: Zalthir jumps off the mesa and heads to an alcove in the northeast corner. There, he picks up the statue of Demogorgon. “Leemooggoogoon, Demogorgon, two-headed baby dragons - …” he thinks to himself.

subject: beholder-like creature
fact: A creature similar to but different from a beholder is present near Eldeth at the tunnel entrance, its origin, allegiance, and purpose unknown.
source_quote: Where Eldeth is, near the tunnel entrance is a spectator, a creature similar to but different from a beholder.

subject: Derro Liberation Plan
fact: A rumored plan by Pliinki to free the Derro from Duergar bondage, which Diirdeklin and Diinarnnmyr have heard before and now suspect may be compromised by Drow incursions.
source_quote: Pliinki has promised him that this is part of some plan that will free the Derro from the bondage of Duergar.

subject: Drow-Duergar Alliance Rumor
fact: A rumor propagated by Diinarnnmyr that The Ember Vanguard’s Drow are secretly allied with the Duergar to subjugate the Derro, contradicting the Drow’s actual independent actions.
source_quote: The Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!

subject: Empty Scabbard Killers
fact: A hostile faction rumored to inhabit the southern tunnels, whose threat prompted The Ember Vanguard to avoid retracing their path and instead take a new route.
source_quote: The Empty Scabbard Killers might want to kill us.

subject: fate of the egg
fact: Grygum declares the egg must be returned to Gartokkar so that Themberchaud may have its revenge — a decision that contradicts both the Cult's plans and the Deepking's ignorance, creating a volatile pivot point in the conflict.
source_quote: "We shall return the egg to Gartokkar. When this abomination hatches, the dragon Themberchaud will have its revenge on those who would think to control it."

subject: ghostly possession
fact: Pelek’s body is occupied by an unknown ghostly entity, and the nature of this possession — whether temporary, voluntary, or part of a larger ritual — remains unexplained.
source_quote: "Oh, yes, I am Pelek. I seem to have occupied this body."

subject: missing egg
fact: The Red Dragon Egg is missing from its expected location, though Daz claims possession — raising uncertainty about its true whereabouts, state, and whether it has hatched or been concealed.
source_quote: There is no egg. ... Daz shouts back, "I have it."

subject: The Ember Vanguard
fact: The group adopts the name "The Ember Vanguard," but its origins and true purpose remain undefined beyond Thorin's impulsive suggestion.
source_quote: I have it - The Ember Vanguard.
